name: padlock reveal over an encrypted credential card
looks: On a near-black field, a glossy padlock icon hangs above a small mono caption. A headline ("Your passwords, sealed.") types in beneath it as a credential card fades up showing masked, encrypted field values and a security caption.
build: glass-ui-flow: the padlock is a DOM/SVG icon with a soft glow and a subtle vertical float; the card uses backdrop-filter blur and a 1px border, its fields set from the clock with the password shown as a monospace hash string.
sound: A soft low drone, a single mechanical click as the lock settles.
prompt: Hang a glossy lock icon over a dark field with a soft glow, then type in a short reassurance line about security. Fade up a credential card beneath it with its sensitive field shown masked or hashed, to make the security claim visible rather than just stated.
